tinipings.name: Heartsping
tinipings.desc: The Royal Teenieping of love; she is in charge of taking care of Romi. Heart-themed, she is full of love and deeply cares for her friends.

tinipings.name: Dadaping
tinipings.desc: The Royal Emotion Teenieping of rightness; he is studious, smart, and organized. Cloud-themed, he often helps the team with his large knowledge and inventive ideas.

tinipings.name: Gogoping
tinipings.desc: The Royal Emotion Teenieping of courage; he is sporty, brave, and energetic. Star-themed, he likes challenges and impulsive actions.

tinipings.name: Chachaping
tinipings.desc: The Royal Emotion Teenieping of hope; she has a calm personality. Nature-themed, she loves nature and flowers and never loses hope.

tinipings.name: Lalaping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of joy, she is energetic and cheerful. Music-themed, she likes to sing loudly to express her feelings.

tinipings.name: Happying
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of happiness, sunshine-themed, she appears as the last missing Royal Teenieping who was secretly transformed into Giggleping.

tinipings.name: Giggleping
tinipings.desc: An unidentified Teenieping who likes to make tricks and pranks.

tinipings.name: Egoping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of selfishness, she appears as the final boss of Season 1.

tinipings.name: Kikiping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of malice, he is noisy and foolish. He likes to play mischievous pranks.

tinipings.name: Charmping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of cuteness, she lives only for cuteness and loves to eat cotton candy.

tinipings.name: Shyping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of shyness, she is shy and gets easily embarrassed.

tinipings.name: Dareping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of competitiveness, he loves challenges and winning.

tinipings.name: Blankping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of obliviousness, he is lazy and clumsy and forgets various things.

tinipings.name: Dreamping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of imagination, she likes to trick people with her magic.

tinipings.name: Weeping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of sadness, she likes rainy days, but feels happy when eating tear candy.

tinipings.name: Moseyping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of laziness, he is lazy and always tired.

tinipings.name: Roarping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of anger, he gets angry easily.

tinipings.name: Nonoping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of rejection, he says no to everything, but he loves broccoli.

tinipings.name: Luvping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of attraction, she lives only for love.

tinipings.name: Coolping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of coldness, he used to live in a fridge as he only loves cold things.

tinipings.name: Joahping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of kindness, who is kind, warm and sensitive. Wielding the Emerald.

tinipings.name: Teeheeping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of laughter, with a tomboy personality. Wielding the Ruby.

tinipings.name: Trustping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of trust, he is cute and naive. Wielding the Sapphire.

tinipings.name: Maskping
tinipings.desc: The mysterious masked villain of Season 2.

tinipings.name: Tickleping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of mischief, wielding the Citrine. She is playful and mischievous.

tinipings.name: Wishping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of desire, wielding the Spinel. She grants 3 wishes to anyone she encounters.

tinipings.name: Okeydokeyping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of peace, with a gentle and caring personality. Winter-themed.

tinipings.name: Nanaping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of passion, full of devotion and confidence. Sunshine-themed.

tinipings.name: Trueping
tinipings.desc: The Teenieping of honesty, with a cute but grumbly type of personality.

tinipings.name: Luckyping
tinipings.desc: The Legend Teenieping of luck, she is locked in a box for most of the season.

tinipings.name: Shashaping
tinipings.desc: The ice cream-themed Teenieping of positivity, she has an optimistic and positive state of mind.

tinipings.name: Fluffyping
tinipings.desc: The cotton candy-themed Teenieping of purity, she is kind to everyone.

tinipings.name: Jellyping
tinipings.desc: The jelly-themed Teenieping of enthusiasm, she has a lively and quirky personality.

tinipings.name: Sweetping
tinipings.desc: The Legend sweet-themed Teenieping of sweetness. Her powers endure for eternity.

tinipings.name: Shimmerping
tinipings.desc: The gentle and emotional Teenieping of healing, she is gentle and filled with kindness.

tinipings.name: Sparkleping
tinipings.desc: The confident and lively Teenieping of wishes, she is confident and fearless.

tinipings.name: Twinkleping
tinipings.desc: The bright and quirky Teenieping of brightness, she is immaculate and bright.

tinipings.name: Princeping
tinipings.desc: The regal but sorrowful Teenieping of excellence. He is loyal and dedicated.

tinipings.name: Auroraping
tinipings.desc: The Legend Teenieping of promise. She is gentle, kind and loves the stars.

tinipings.name: Graceping
tinipings.desc: The Royal Princess Teenieping of grace, she has a gentle exterior and a strong heart.

tinipings.name: Claireping
tinipings.desc: The Royal Princess Teenieping of beauty, she has a pure and innocent personality.

tinipings.name: Bonnyping
tinipings.desc: The Royal Princess Teenieping of confidence, she has a cheerful and outgoing personality.

tinipings.name: Eclipseping
tinipings.desc: The Legend Princess Teenieping of seclusion.

tinipings.name: Dianaping
tinipings.desc: The Legend Princess Teenieping of glory.
